trust_decision.summary: Caller-supplied metadata filter values and field names are treated as literal data, not RediSearch query syntax, when @langchain/redis builds the FT.SEARCH hybrid query string (filter classes in filters.ts and the RedisVectorStore query builders in vectorstores.ts).

landing_point.why: The summary names 'Tag/Text values'; TagFilter.toString and TextFilter.toString are the obvious tag/text query builders, and the package docs lead with Tag()/Text().

Geo(field).within/outside / new GeoFilter -> FluentRedisVectorStore search (field-name check only)

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: TextFilter wildcard mode must keep * and ? as live operators (and whitespace must stay token separators in text/match), while tag values escape whitespace; separately, legacy-store metadata is stored with escapeSpecialChars (-, :, ") and read back with unEscapeSpecialChars, so string[] filter matching against stored metadata must keep working. Escaping everything, or rejecting special characters, breaks these.
